task.title: [M1] Artwork ledger and explicit transform-reuse graph
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M1
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M1-03
**Implementation status:** Implemented; corrected independent QA_PASS obtained. Accepted via existing workflow after evidence/checklist synchronization.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex primary session. Independent reviewer: /root/rsf9_independent_qa (configured forge_qa_reviewer, read-only).
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.3, 3.1, 3.4, 4.3–4.4, 6/M1
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Record exactly which supplied artwork fulfills each ordered requirement and who approved reuse.

**Scope:** Source-hash assignments, transforms/crops, reuse edges, cycle validation and orthogonal review/validity records.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Ledger maps stable part/action/view/frame/layer IDs to exact source hash, crop/transform recipe, revisions and declared reuse; attachment parent/child/anchor links are explicit.
- [x] Reuse graph detects cycles, invalid/missing references and hash changes; mirroring/transform reuse counts only when explicitly declared and accepted.
- [x] Missing source, invalid hash, available-but-unapproved art, reused original/classic fallback and runtime unsupported states remain distinct.
- [x] Source-art effort counts derive only from declared approved reuse; duplicate decoded pixels never imply aesthetic equivalence or newly authored replacement coverage.

## Verification

Graph cycle and broken-edge tests; mixed validation/review/runtime states and explicit versus inferred reuse regression cases.

Actual commands, exit statuses and hashes are recorded in docs/evidence/rsf9/VERIFICATION.md, test-results.json and QA_REVIEW.md. CPython3.14.4:153 public/16 private/34 ledger tests; existing3 schemas13valid55invalid,newledger1schema4valid8invalid; installed153 and repeat wheel/package exclusions PASS. All commands exit0. Python3.12/3.13 unavailable NOT_RUN; fresh Rust parity/native playback NOT_RUN because those inputs are unchanged. No artwork approvals generated.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-8 (M1-02; task ID akj2012swhvsebugprsl0v5j)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No automatic visual approval, generated imagery or runtime fallback completion.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- New immutable assignment-ledger/v1, source identity/observations, direct/reuse/unassigned occurrences, ordered crop/mirror/offset/rational-scale/rotation recipes, explicit attachment links, iterative graph/cycle validation, resolved-ledger/v1 and ledger-impact/v1. Existing target/topology contracts remain unchanged.
- CLI ledger and ledger-impact use typed diagnostics and atomic no-overwrite report publication. Image processing is not implemented or claimed. VALID means observed nonempty content/hash identity only; no visual approval follows from validity.
- Exact changed paths/hashes: docs/evidence/rsf9/implementation-manifest.json SHA256 f0c0a7a125e25b1430da6f895c1d5ddcdf5d818aa188f550bee70a7d0520f74b.
- Accepted163-file baseline manifest SHA256 5b670c840feeb00c8ba34c3830140e2382fe366ffd86498f9b1885c8c9e47f16 and archived source retained; only preexisting cli.py changed. No commit/push; private art excluded. Unrelated operator files preserved.
- Synthetic computed48frames/48layers:2direct,2explicit reuse,44unassigned,zero approved roots/accepted reuse. A→B→C retains mirror→translate; source A change affects A/B/C, D unaffected. examples.json SHA25626c83addfa19fd636ee41067f9d1357b9d461d1d36a0399e459cf50ade7e5ed8.
- Existing private Novice body/head and Orc hashes/counts/topology remain unchanged; imported topology does not assign replacement art.
- M0-S PASS,M0-I PASS,M0-N PASS; previously accepted M0_VERIFIED remains applicable. No new native/artistic acceptance, coverage evaluation or export readiness claim.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

QA_PASS after one corrected finding. Initial QA_FAIL: a sealed malformed resolved report could cause KeyError/CLI traceback instead of typed INVALID_INPUT. Implementer added bounded report shape/enums/identity/reference/cycle checks and3 regressions. Reviewer independently reproduced correction:exit3,no traceback/no output;284 additional malformed report probes all typed,zero unhandled exceptions. Reviewer independently reran153public,16private,bothschema checks,installed153/repeatwheel/exclusions PASS on final manifest. See docs/evidence/rsf9/QA_REVIEW.md SHA256cd47c01db370a650bc55f2abddfd91cb757491a5014d1d1d3aab033192a38161. Reviewer made no implementation/Kaneo edits. Operator-only visual/native decisions remain separate.

next_task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M1
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M1-04
**Implementation status:** Backlog (to-do); planned only, no implementation or verification claimed. Kaneo column is authoritative if later changed.
**Responsible implementer:** Unassigned. Required skill: Authorized engineer for this bounded deliverable; independent reviewer is separate.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§3.3–3.4, 4.4, 6/M1, 12, 14
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Give the operator an exact production checklist before artwork creation.

**Scope:** Requirements/ledger comparison, missing/report CLI exports and orthogonal completeness decisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New fully declared monster target produces exact finite frame/layer checklist without artwork, including part, semantic action/numeric slot when known, view/frame/layer ordinal/role, required status and topology provenance.
- [ ] Report separate frame occurrences, layer occurrences, stored/referenced identities/content classes and approved reuse; no misleading single effort count.
- [ ] Missing, invalid, unreviewed, excluded, original fallback, runtime unsupported and unverified attachments remain separately actionable with exact IDs.
- [ ] COMPLETE_FOR_DECLARED_SCOPE requires specified topology and valid approved required assignments; COMPLETE_FOR_FULL_PROFILE additionally covers full profile. Visual, preview and native evidence stay independent.
- [ ] CLI/core reports expose precise remaining gaps and declaration/inheritance unknowns; one-view/one-action completion never becomes full-profile completion.

## Verification

No-art checklist golden tests, mixed-state ledger coverage tests and scoped/full negative cases; independent QA compares exact IDs.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-9 (M1-03; task ID bbiahdelxdqg6o5aupyfj699)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** Only the stated deliverable; no adjacent milestone implementation or automatic artistic/native acceptance.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence (add at QA handoff)

- Code changes / diff: Not implemented by this planning sync.
- Test commands / exit statuses / artifact hashes: NOT_RUN (planning only).
- Milestone gates / limitations: Not evaluated; structural, coverage, visual, preview and native states remain separate.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

Not performed for implementation. Implementer supplies evidence and moves to QA Review; a distinct read-only reviewer records QA_PASS / QA_FAIL / QA_BLOCKED. Operator-only visual/native decisions remain separate. No acceptance is granted by backlog creation.
